## 3. Symbols (\`:symbol\`)
Ini konsep paling unik di Ruby.
- **String:** Mutable (bisa diubah), boros memori.
- **Symbol:** Immutable (kekal), hemat memori, diawali titik dua \`:\`.

\`\`\`ruby
# String: Object ID berbeda tiap dibuat
puts "halo".object_id 
puts "halo".object_id 

# Symbol: Object ID selalu sama (Efisien)
puts :halo.object_id
puts :halo.object_id
\`\`\`
